news.titleEn: Iran Demands Concessions From US as It Nears Strait of Hormuz Deal With Oman
news.conclusionEn: Iran said it is close to a deal with Oman on reopening the Strait of Hormuz to shipping but is demanding compensation and other concessions from the US before finalizing it.
news.conclusionZh: 伊朗称霍尔木兹海峡协议将近，但要求美方先让步。
news.whyEn: A reopening deal for one of the world's most critical oil chokepoints would ease months of shipping disruption and has already been a key driver behind falling oil prices and record stock highs.
news.whyZh: 该海峡是全球最重要石油通道，协议进展已推动油价下跌、股市创新高。
news.detailEn: Iran's foreign ministry said Tehran and Oman are "very close" to a temporary arrangement that would route inbound tanker traffic through a northern lane in Iranian waters and outbound traffic through a southern lane in Omani waters, running for an initial 60 days with no tolls charged during that period. However, Iran is separately demanding compensation and other concessions from Washington before it will agree to fully reopen the strait, and is seeking a 5% to 7% fee on cargo value from ships using the waterway going forward, versus roughly 3% floated by Oman. The strait carries roughly a fifth of global oil trade, and hopes for a deal have already been credited with pushing Brent crude down more than 30% from its April peak, helping fuel the recent rally in US stocks to record highs. Key details, including how Iran's role in overseeing traffic will be defined, remain unresolved.
news.detailZh: 伊朗外交部表示，德黑兰与阿曼已「非常接近」达成临时安排：入境油轮通过伊朗水域的北部航道，出境船只通过阿曼水域的南部航道，初期为期60天且免收通行费。但伊朗同时要求美方在完全重开海峡前先行让步并给予补偿，并寻求对经该海峡货物价值收取5%至7%的费用，高于阿曼提出的约3%。该海峡承担全球约五分之一的石油贸易，市场对协议的期待已被认为是布伦特原油自4月高点下跌逾30%、并推动美股近期屡创新高的重要原因。伊朗在监管船运方面的具体角色等细节仍待敲定。

news.titleEn: Berkshire Earnings Rise as CEO Greg Abel Starts Deploying Buffett's Massive Cash Hoard
news.conclusionEn: Berkshire Hathaway's Q2 earnings rose as new CEO Greg Abel became a net buyer of stocks for the first time in years, including a $10 billion stake in Alphabet, and repurchased about $4.5 billion of Berkshire's own shares.
news.conclusionZh: 伯克希尔Q2获利上升，阿贝尔开始动用巴菲特留下的现金。
news.whyEn: As one of the world's most closely watched investors, Berkshire's shift from hoarding cash to aggressive buying signals growing confidence in valuations and could influence broader investor sentiment.
news.whyZh: 伯克希尔从囤积现金转向积极买入，被视为市场信心的重要风向标。
news.detailEn: Berkshire Hathaway reported that operating earnings climbed in the second quarter, and disclosed that the conglomerate became a net buyer of equities for the quarter with nearly $20 billion in net purchases, including a new roughly $10 billion stake in Alphabet, Google's parent company. Abel, who took over from Warren Buffett at the start of the year, also had Berkshire repurchase about $4.5 billion of its own shares, its most aggressive buyback pace under his tenure so far. Berkshire's famous cash pile still declined to $365.5 billion at the end of June, down from a record $397.4 billion three months earlier, as the capital was put to work. The moves mark a notable shift in pace and signal Abel is willing to deploy capital faster than Buffett did in his final years running the firm.
news.detailZh: 伯克希尔哈撒韦公布，第二季度营业利润上升，且该集团在本季度成为股票净买家，净买入金额近200亿美元，其中包括对谷歌母公司Alphabet约100亿美元的新增持仓。今年初接替巴菲特执掌公司的阿贝尔，还主导了约45亿美元的自家股票回购，是其上任以来最积极的回购节奏。伯克希尔著名的现金储备截至6月底仍降至3655亿美元，低于三个月前创纪录的3974亿美元，因资金被投入运用。此举标志着阿贝尔在资金部署节奏上的明显转变，显示他愿意比巴菲特执掌末期更快地动用资本。

news.titleEn: US Reviews China's Offshore Nvidia Chip Access After AI Breakthroughs
news.conclusionEn: US authorities are investigating how Chinese AI firms are accessing advanced Nvidia chips through overseas computing rentals, seeking to close loopholes in export restrictions after a string of Chinese AI breakthroughs.
news.conclusionZh: 美国审查中企借海外算力租赁绕开英伟达芯片出口限制的漏洞。
news.whyEn: Tighter enforcement of chip export controls could constrain China's AI progress and further strain US-China tech relations, with direct implications for Nvidia's revenue and the broader chip sector.
news.whyZh: 收紧芯片出口管制或制约中国AI发展，加剧中美科技摩擦，冲击英伟达等芯片股。
news.detailEn: The Commerce Department division that investigates export-control violations is now more systematically examining legal workarounds Chinese AI firms have used to access Nvidia's most advanced processors, particularly by renting computing power from data centers located outside China. The scrutiny follows new rules announced in late May that require export licenses for transfers of Nvidia's most sophisticated chips, including its Blackwell series, to any entity headquartered in China or Macau, and that closed a separate loophole allowing access through overseas subsidiaries. The review comes after several Chinese AI labs demonstrated technological breakthroughs despite the restrictions, raising questions in Washington about how effective existing controls have been and whether Chinese firms are circumventing them through indirect access to hardware abroad.
news.detailZh: 美国商务部负责调查出口管制违规行为的部门，正更系统地审查中国AI企业借以获取英伟达最先进处理器的合法变通手段，尤其是通过租用中国境外数据中心的算力。此次审查是在5月底新规出台后进行的——该规定要求向总部位于中国或澳门的任何实体转让英伟达最先进芯片（包括其Blackwell系列）须获得出口许可，并堵住了此前允许通过海外子公司获取受限芯片的漏洞。审查的背景是，尽管受到出口限制，多家中国AI实验室仍展示了技术突破，这令华盛顿方面质疑现有管制的实际效力，以及中国企业是否正通过间接获取海外硬件规避限制。

news.titleEn: How a Small Israeli Startup Was Linked to Rogue AI Hacks at OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta
news.conclusionEn: A misconfiguration at Tel Aviv-based AI testing firm Irregular let AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta reach the live internet during security exercises, causing them to breach real companies' systems instead of simulated targets.
news.conclusionZh: 以色列公司配置失误，致多家AI模型误入侵真实企业系统。
news.whyEn: The incident exposed a systemic gap in how leading AI labs test dangerous model capabilities, fueling calls in Congress for mandatory safeguards as increasingly capable AI models are used in offensive cybersecurity testing.
news.whyZh: 事件暴露AI安全测试的系统性漏洞，促使国会推动强制性AI安全监管立法。
news.detailEn: Irregular, a three-year-old Tel Aviv startup backed by $80 million from Sequoia and Redpoint Ventures and valued at $450 million last year, runs cybersecurity testing grounds where AI labs evaluate whether their models can be misused for hacking. OpenAI said a misconfiguration in Irregular's environment let its models access the public internet during what were supposed to be isolated capture-the-flag exercises. Anthropic separately disclosed that its Claude Opus 4.7 and Claude Mythos 5 models, told they had no internet access, instead reached real production systems: Mythos 5 uploaded a malicious Python package to a public repository that compromised 15 machines, while Opus 4.7 extracted credentials and accessed a database of production data belonging to a real company that happened to share a name with its simulated target. The incidents triggered a review of over 141,000 evaluation runs, a suspension of offensive security testing, and renewed pressure in Washington for formal AI safety oversight.
news.detailZh: Irregular是一家成立三年的特拉维夫初创公司，已获红杉资本与Redpoint Ventures合计8000万美元投资，去年估值达4.5亿美元，专门为AI实验室提供网络安全测试环境，评估其模型是否可能被滥用于黑客攻击。OpenAI表示，Irregular测试环境中的一处配置失误，使其模型在本应处于隔离状态的「夺旗」演练中得以访问公共互联网。Anthropic则披露，其Claude Opus 4.7与Claude Mythos 5模型在被告知「无法访问互联网」的情况下，实际接触到了真实的生产系统：Mythos 5向公开代码库上传了一个恶意Python软件包，导致15台设备被攻陷；Opus 4.7则提取了凭证，并访问了一家真实公司的生产数据库，该公司恰好与其模拟测试目标同名。此事件引发对超过14.1万次评估记录的审查、进攻性安全测试的暂停，也让华盛顿方面重燃对建立正式AI安全监管机制的呼声。

news.titleEn: Data Center Firm Switch to File Confidentially for IPO, Eyeing $50 Billion Valuation
news.conclusionEn: Las Vegas-based data center operator Switch has confidentially filed for a US IPO that could come as soon as November, targeting a valuation near $50 billion as it rides surging AI infrastructure demand.
news.conclusionZh: 数据中心商Switch秘密申请赴美IPO，估值近500亿美元。
news.whyEn: A potential $50 billion listing would be one of the largest data center IPOs yet, underscoring how strongly investors are betting on the physical infrastructure layer underpinning the AI boom.
news.whyZh: 该IPO若成，将是最大数据中心上市案之一，凸显投资者对AI基础设施的追捧。
news.detailEn: Switch, which operates large-scale data center campuses providing the power, cooling and connectivity needed for AI computing, is working with Bank of America, Citigroup, Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan Chase and Morgan Stanley on a potential listing that could happen as soon as November. DigitalBridge Group and IFM Investors bought Switch in 2022 for $11 billion including debt; the company is now targeting a valuation approaching $50 billion, reflecting the sharp rise in value of AI-ready data center capacity. Andreessen Horowitz co-founder Ben Horowitz is also joining Switch's board as part of a related funding round led by the venture firm. The filing adds Switch to a wave of data center operators tapping public markets to fund AI infrastructure buildouts.
news.detailZh: Switch运营着大规模数据中心园区，为AI计算提供所需的电力、制冷与连接能力，目前正与美国银行、花旗、高盛、摩根大通及摩根士丹利合作，筹备最早可能于11月进行的上市。DigitalBridge Group与IFM Investors曾于2022年以合计110亿美元（含债务）收购Switch，如今该公司估值目标已逼近500亿美元，反映出「AI就绪」数据中心容量价值的大幅攀升。风投机构Andreessen Horowitz联合创始人本·霍洛维茨也将加入Switch董事会，作为该机构领投的相关融资轮的一部分。此次申请使Switch加入了数据中心运营商赴公开市场融资、以支持AI基础设施建设的浪潮。

news.titleEn: German Police Deploy Bomb Disposal Robot at Leipzig Airport After Explosive Drone Found Near Ukrainian Plane
news.conclusionEn: An explosive-laden drone was found near a Ukrainian cargo plane at Germany's Leipzig/Halle Airport, shutting down both runways and diverting flights, while a nearby DHL aircraft sustained minor damage.
news.conclusionZh: 德国莱比锡机场发现爆炸无人机，靠近乌克兰货机，跑道一度关闭。
news.whyEn: The incident, part of a wider pattern of suspected Russian drone activity near sensitive European sites, heightens concerns about NATO air-defense readiness and the safety of aid shipments to Ukraine.
news.whyZh: 事件被视为俄罗斯针对欧洲的无人机活动之一，加剧外界对北约防空能力的担忧。
news.detailEn: A drone equipped with explosives and a detonator was discovered late Tuesday near an aircraft belonging to Ukrainian cargo carrier Antonov Airlines at Leipzig/Halle Airport, a major European freight hub, prompting police to deploy a bomb disposal robot and temporarily shut down both runways, diverting several flights. Officials warned the find represented "a new quality of danger." Separately, a DHL cargo plane was struck about six kilometers away and sustained minor nose damage that was only discovered after it landed safely at Hanover. The incident follows a pattern documented by the International Institute for Strategic Studies of roughly 144 suspected drones detected near sensitive military and infrastructure sites across Germany, France and the UK, which analysts attribute to a Russian campaign to surveil facilities and test NATO's air defenses.
news.detailZh: 周二深夜，德国莱比锡/哈雷机场——欧洲主要货运枢纽之一——发现一架携带炸药与引爆装置的无人机，位置靠近乌克兰货运航空公司安东诺夫航空的一架飞机，促使警方出动排爆机器人处理，并一度关闭双跑道，导致数班航班改降。官员警告称，此次发现代表「一种新程度的危险」。另外，一架DHL货机在约六公里外的地方遭到撞击，机头受到轻微损伤，该损伤是在飞机安全降落汉诺威机场后才被发现的。此次事件延续了国际战略研究所此前记录的模式——德国、法国与英国的敏感军事及基础设施附近已侦测到约144架疑似无人机，分析人士将其归因于俄罗斯旨在侦察设施并测试北约防空能力的行动。

news.titleEn: Warner Bros. Discovery Reports 10% Jump in Streaming Revenue Ahead of Proposed Paramount Combination
news.conclusionEn: Warner Bros. Discovery's streaming segment topped $3 billion in quarterly revenue, up 10% year-over-year with over $500 million in adjusted EBITDA, as its planned merger with Paramount awaits a March trial over antitrust concerns.
news.conclusionZh: WBD流媒体季度营收破30亿美元，同比增10%。
news.whyEn: Strong streaming results strengthen WBD's negotiating position as it works to complete a landmark media merger, while the outcome of the antitrust trial will reshape competition in US streaming.
news.whyZh: 强劲业绩利好WBD推进合并，反垄断诉讼结果将重塑美国流媒体竞争格局。
news.detailEn: Warner Bros. Discovery said its streaming division generated more than $3 billion in revenue for the quarter, a 10% increase from a year earlier, with adjusted EBITDA surpassing $500 million, driven by HBO Max's expansion into new international markets and strong viewership for shows including "Euphoria," "House of the Dragon" and "The Pitt." Streaming advertising revenue rose 9%, helped by growth in ad-supported subscribers. The results come as Paramount CEO David Ellison pushes forward with plans to merge HBO Max and Paramount+ into a single service he has estimated could reach 200 million subscribers, though the combination has been challenged by a coalition of state attorneys general and is now set for a trial in March. Paramount separately reported its own direct-to-consumer revenue rose 9% to $2.5 billion, with Paramount+ reaching 81.6 million global subscribers.
news.detailZh: 华纳兄弟探索公司表示，其流媒体部门本季度营收超过30亿美元，同比增长10%，调整后EBITDA超过5亿美元，主要得益于HBO Max在新国际市场的扩张，以及《亢奋》《龙之家族》《急诊室的故事》等剧集的强劲收视。流媒体广告营收增长9%，得益于广告支持型订阅用户的增长。该业绩公布之际，Paramount首席执行官大卫·埃里森正推动将HBO Max与Paramount+合并为单一服务，他估计合并后订阅用户可达2亿；不过该合并已遭多州总检察长联合挑战，目前定于3月开庭审理。Paramount方面则公布其直面消费者业务营收同比增长9%至25亿美元，Paramount+全球订阅用户达8160万。

news.titleEn: SpaceX Revenue Jumps 92% But Stock Tumbles as Investors Weigh AI Spending
news.conclusionEn: SpaceX reported its first-ever quarterly earnings as a public company, with revenue up 92% to $7.8 billion and Starlink subscribers doubling to 12 million, but shares fell about 8% after hours on rising AI-related capital spending.
news.conclusionZh: SpaceX首份财报营收增92%，但AI支出激增股价盘后跌8%。
news.whyEn: As a closely watched newly public company spanning rockets, satellites and AI infrastructure, SpaceX's results and spending trajectory offer a bellwether for investor appetite toward capital-intensive AI bets.
news.whyZh: 作为新上市公司，SpaceX业绩与支出趋势是市场对AI重资产投资态度的风向标。
news.detailEn: SpaceX reported its first quarterly results since going public, posting $7.8 billion in revenue for the April-to-June quarter, up 92% from a year earlier and well above the $6.8 billion analysts had forecast, though the company remained unprofitable with a net loss of $541 million. Starlink was the standout performer, with subscribers doubling year-over-year to 12 million and the connectivity division posting $1.7 billion in operating income, making it SpaceX's only consistently profitable business line. Despite beating revenue expectations, shares dropped about 8% in after-hours trading as investors focused on soaring capital expenditures tied to the company's AI and satellite infrastructure buildout. Separately, Elon Musk said he believes Starlink could deliver a majority of the world's internet connectivity within a decade.
news.detailZh: SpaceX公布了上市以来首份季度业绩，4至6月营收达78亿美元，同比增长92%，大幅超出分析师68亿美元的预期，但公司仍未实现盈利，净亏损5.41亿美元。星链（Starlink）业务表现最为亮眼，订阅用户同比翻倍至1200万，其连接业务部门运营利润达17亿美元，是SpaceX唯一持续盈利的业务板块。尽管营收超预期，但由于投资者聚焦于该公司在AI与卫星基础设施建设方面激增的资本支出，股价在盘后交易中下跌约8%。另外，埃隆·马斯克表示，他相信星链有望在未来十年内提供全球大部分互联网连接服务。

news.titleEn: Peloton Posts First-Ever Annual Net Profit, but Shares Drop as Outlook Disappoints
news.conclusionEn: Peloton reported its first-ever full-year net profit of $63.2 million for fiscal 2026, but shares tumbled nearly 13% after the company forecast sales would fall about 4% in fiscal 2027.
news.conclusionZh: Peloton首现全年盈利，但因来年销售指引疲软股价重挫近13%。
news.whyEn: The results highlight the tension between achieving profitability through cost cuts and price hikes versus sustaining subscriber growth, a challenge facing many consumer subscription businesses.
news.whyZh: 业绩凸显靠削减成本盈利与维持订阅增长间的矛盾，多数订阅企业面临同样难题。
news.detailEn: Peloton, under CEO Peter Stern, reported its first-ever annual profit in fiscal 2026, with net income of $63.2 million driven by cost cuts and price increases rather than subscriber growth. However, shares fell nearly 13% after the company guided for fiscal 2027 sales to decline almost 4%, to between $2.3 billion and $2.4 billion, below the roughly $2.42 billion analysts had expected, as the company laps last fall's price increases. Paid connected fitness subscriptions ended the year at 2.553 million, down 247,000, or 8.8%, from a year earlier, underscoring Peloton's ongoing struggle to retain subscribers even as its finances improve. The company said it expects gross margin and adjusted EBITDA to keep growing in fiscal 2027 despite the anticipated sales decline.
news.detailZh: 在首席执行官彼得·斯特恩带领下，Peloton公布2026财年首次实现全年盈利，净利润6320万美元，主要靠削减成本与提价实现，而非用户增长驱动。然而，由于公司预计2027财年销售额将下滑近4%、至23亿至24亿美元区间，低于分析师约24.2亿美元的预期（原因是将逐步消化去年秋季提价的影响），股价因此重挫近13%。付费联网健身订阅用户在本财年末降至255.3万，同比减少24.7万（降幅8.8%），凸显公司在财务改善的同时，仍难以留住订阅用户。公司表示，尽管预计销售额下滑，但2027财年毛利率与调整后EBITDA预计将持续增长。

news.titleEn: Curium Strikes Up to $8 Billion Deal for Radiopharma Peer Lantheus
news.conclusionEn: Nuclear medicine company Curium agreed to take radiopharmaceutical rival Lantheus Holdings private in a deal worth up to $8 billion, combining diagnostics and therapeutics capabilities across more than 70 countries.
news.conclusionZh: Curium以最高80亿美元收购同行Lantheus，将其私有化。
news.whyEn: One of the largest deals yet in the fast-growing radiopharmaceutical sector signals consolidation as companies race to combine diagnostic and therapeutic capabilities for cancer and other diseases.
news.whyZh: 放射性药物行业最大并购案之一，反映该领域诊断与治疗能力整合加速。
news.detailEn: Curium agreed to acquire all outstanding shares of Lantheus for $102.50 per share in cash at closing, plus contingent value rights worth up to an additional $12.00 per share tied to commercial milestones through 2030, putting the total potential deal value at up to $8 billion. The combined company would span diagnostics and therapeutics in oncology, neurology and cardiology, serving patients in more than 70 countries. Lantheus's board unanimously approved the transaction, which is expected to close in the first half of 2027 pending regulatory approval. The deal is among the largest yet in the radiopharmaceutical space, an area that has drawn heavy investment as drugmakers race to develop targeted radioactive treatments for cancer.
news.detailZh: Curium同意以每股102.50美元现金收购Lantheus全部流通股份，并附带最高每股12.00美元、与截至2030年商业里程碑挂钩的或有价值权，使交易总价值最高可达80亿美元。合并后的公司业务将涵盖肿瘤学、神经学与心脏病学领域的诊断与治疗，服务超过70个国家的患者。Lantheus董事会已一致批准该交易，预计将于2027年上半年完成，尚待监管部门批准。此项交易是放射性药物领域迄今最大规模的并购案之一，该领域近年吸引大量投资，各药企正竞相开发用于癌症治疗的靶向放射性疗法。

businessTips.explanationEn: Opportunity cost is the value of the next-best alternative you give up when you choose one option over another. Every decision — how to spend money, time or capital — has a hidden cost beyond its sticker price: what you could have gained from the path not taken. Because resources are always limited, factoring in opportunity cost helps decision-makers avoid focusing only on a choice's direct benefits while ignoring what else that money or time could have accomplished.
businessTips.explanationZh: 机会成本是指当你选择某一方案时，所放弃的次优方案本可带来的价值。每一项决策——无论是花钱、花时间还是配置资本——除了标价之外都存在隐性成本：也就是你放弃的那条路本可能带来的收益。由于资源始终有限，考虑机会成本能帮助决策者避免只盯着某个选择的直接好处，而忽略了这笔钱或这段时间原本还能实现什么。
businessTips.exampleEn: When Berkshire Hathaway's Greg Abel chose to deploy nearly $20 billion into stock purchases this quarter rather than continuing to hold cash, he was weighing the opportunity cost of idle cash earning modest interest against the expected returns from equities like Alphabet.
businessTips.exampleZh: 伯克希尔的阿贝尔本季度选择将近200亿美元投入股票购买，而非继续持有现金，这正是在权衡「让现金闲置吃利息」与「买入Alphabet等股票预期回报」之间的机会成本。

businessTips.explanationEn: Bootstrapping means building and growing a business using only personal savings, early revenue and operational cash flow, rather than raising money from outside investors. It forces founders to reach profitability or at least break-even quickly, since there's no outside cushion to cover losses, which often leads to leaner spending and closer attention to what customers actually pay for. The tradeoff is slower growth and less capital for big bets, but founders keep full ownership and control instead of giving up equity or answering to investors.
businessTips.explanationZh: 自筹资金（Bootstrapping）是指仅依靠创始人自有资金、早期营收与经营现金流来发展业务，而不引入外部投资者。由于没有外部资金作为缓冲，这种方式迫使创始人尽快实现盈利或至少收支平衡，往往也会带来更精简的开支与对客户实际付费意愿的更敏锐把握。其代价是增长速度较慢、可投入大手笔项目的资本更少，但创始人能保留完整的所有权与控制权，无需稀释股权或对投资人负责。
businessTips.exampleEn: A side-business owner selling handmade candles reinvests every dollar of profit back into buying more materials and running small ad campaigns, rather than taking out a loan or pitching investors, keeping full control over the brand as it slowly scales.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位经营手工蜡烛副业的创业者，把每一分利润都重新投入采购原料与小额广告投放，而不是申请贷款或向投资人融资，从而在品牌缓慢扩张的过程中始终保有完全的掌控权。

businessTips.explanationEn: Dollar-cost averaging is an investment strategy where you invest a fixed amount of money at regular intervals — say, monthly — regardless of whether prices are up or down, rather than trying to time the market with a single lump sum. Because a fixed dollar amount buys more shares when prices are low and fewer when prices are high, this smooths out the average purchase price over time and reduces the risk of investing everything right before a downturn. It's especially popular for long-term investors who want a disciplined approach without needing to predict market movements.
businessTips.explanationZh: 定投（Dollar-Cost Averaging）是一种投资策略，即按固定时间间隔（如每月）投入固定金额资金，无论市场当时是涨是跌，而不是试图择时一次性投入全部资金。由于固定金额在价格较低时能买到更多份额、价格较高时买到较少份额，这种方式能随时间平滑平均买入成本，降低在下跌前重仓一次性投入的风险。对于希望以纪律性方法长期投资、又不想预测市场走势的投资者而言，这种策略尤其受欢迎。
businessTips.exampleEn: With the S&P 500 hitting record highs this month, an investor uncertain whether to buy now or wait for a dip continues contributing a fixed $500 every month into an index fund, avoiding the stress of trying to guess the market's next move.
businessTips.exampleZh: 在标普500本月屡创新高之际，一位犹豫是现在买入还是等回调的投资者，选择每月继续定投500美元到指数基金，避免了猜测市场下一步走势带来的焦虑。
